description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targeted” and “Untargeted” over the years 2013 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2013 to 2022 in sequential order, while the vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks at intervals of 20.  For each year, there are two bars: a blue bar representing “Targeted” datasets and an orange bar representing “Untargeted” datasets. In 2013, the blue “Targeted” bar is very short, reaching approximately 2, and the orange “Untargeted” bar is also short, reaching approximately 4.  The height of the bars generally increases over time; in 2022, the blue “Targeted” bar reaches approximately 110, and the orange “Untargeted” bar reaches approximately 50. The bars are arranged side-by-side for each year, with “Targeted” consistently to the left of “Untargeted.” No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
